c: Space 54 is the fourth Bonus Stage in Vampire Survivors. This stage can be unlocked by collecting a total of 5
Gold Fingers across any number of runs.

rows.label: Theme
cells: "Moving the sun and the other stars"

c: The 54th ritual is complete, and space itself has folded under the weight of an otherworldly will. This veil between cosmic planes is dimensionally misaligned, phasing in unlikely friends, nightmarish foes, and a curio of immense chaotic potential.
The hyper mode for this stage is unlocked by default after unlocking the stage.

One relic is located in Space 54.

As Menya Moonspell, the player can travel North and find a platform to the left. Once on the platform, enter her boost state and hug the bottom left of the platform. If done correctly, the player will clip through the platform and can move freely.
